description: The four script-management chords every driver offers under « Raccourcis de gestion du script »: AltGr (Windows, Linux) or the right Option key (macOS) with Enter, Backspace, Delete (fn+Delete on a Mac keyboard without the key) or Escape. Each slot is the features manifest entry shortcuts.script_control.<id>, which holds its preset and its default. `ahk` is the AutoHotkey scan code (windows/infra/feature_state.ahk SCRIPT_SHORTCUT_SCAN_CODES), `hs` the macOS keycode of the key and `karabiner` the Karabiner key the sentinel rule reads, `linux` the evdev keycode. `paused_actions` are the only actions a chord runs while the driver is paused. Pinned on the three drivers by tools/test/test-script-chords-three-os.cjs.
